title: One Nal Mhat Tan
note: Hit number one in Myanmar

title: A Ngweh A That Myar (အငွေ့အသက်များ)
note: With ChanMyae MgCho. Peaked at #1 on the JOOX top 100 and won the JOOX 2020 Popular Song Award - the archive's clearest example of a Burmese rap single crossing into the mainstream market.

title: Generation Driven by Faith
note: Posthumous. Opens with a voice note of Zayar Thaw saying he wrote the bars while serving his prison sentence and never finished them. Released through Rap Against Junta.
With JCZ; the hit that raised his profile before Blessed.

title: Nway Thwar Tal
note: With Thar Thar. #1 hit; went viral on TikTok in early 2019 with 50,000+ user videos and was later sampled in an Imagine Dragons melody, per Coconuts.

title: Yabwar Kalu (My People)
note: A S'gaw Karen-language hit. Part of the ethnic-language rap evidence behind the fourth-generation framing.

title: Waytaku Bwar Kanyaw
note: Drill; featured by LIFTED, who note the video is shot on a basketball court.

title: Thit Sar
note: With RELOAD; produced by Ricky Pink. Music video 1.1M views.

title: Push Up
note: With Lil Kee Boi and Ah Sar; cited by Ah Sar's bio as the breakthrough collaboration of the Eagle Element circle.

title: Eyez On Me
note: With KN. Named as a homage to 2Pac's 'Eyez on Me'.

title: Zat Poh
note: Hip pop and R&B over a lo-fi beat; highlighted by LIFTED as a marker of the widened new-wave sound.

title: SMD
note: LIFTED singles this track out for its ferocity as the archive's one documented example of the new wave's harder end.

title: crash out
note: With Murkio.

title: We Got This (Myanmar Song to Fight against Military Dictatorship)
note: Released 18 Feb 2021, within weeks of the coup.

title: Rebel (Save Myanmar)
note: March 2021, from Indianapolis.

title: ATL Flow
note: With X-Boxin. One of the few explicit diaspora signals in the catalogue (Atlanta).

title: 'Nothing will happen when we are together'
note: Lyric quoted by Rap Against Junta in its tribute to Zayar Thaw. Recorded as a quotation in the collective's statement, not as a verified release.

title: ရေရှည်
note: 223 feature with NAY, from 223 Da World. A per-track feature on a lead artist's album, so it resolves the artist through Song rather than through the release's lead credit.

title: Don't Trap
note: With Yan and LiL Max on a 223 Da World track.

title: sin4me
note: With 223 on a 223 Da World track.

title: ရုပ်ရှင်
note: Lil Kee Boi feature on Ah Sar's debut EP - the clearest correction of the common aggregator error that Prodigy Kid is a Kee Boi release.

title: ဘယ်ညာ
note: With Lil Kee Boi, on Ah Sar's album Freemefromeverything. ISRC NL3M12528203.

title: MOMMA I'M CRIMINAL
note: 223 with LiL Max on Zen Music.

title: Green Green
note: Ah Sar feature on Mossberg Arki's album STORY OF A DARK HORSE.

title: အေးဆေး
note: Yungpunch feature on Mossberg Arki's EGO STONE EP.

title: Bal Thu Ko Chit Lal
note: With Reload, N.A.W and 8Ten, from Amygdala.

title: Lost My Way
note: With Myat Amara Maung, from Amygdala.

title: Litt
note: With Moe Htet and Nay Ye Khant, from X-Boxin's album 99. One of the few records that bridges the fourth generation and the post-coup scene; note that 'Nay Ye Khant' here may or may not be the same person as 'NAY' - see artists.json.

title: Fossil
note: Yung Hugo feature on the BG18 project BRAIN GAIN.

title: Naung Kyoe
note: With PHATKIDz and Reload. Confirmed independently on two platforms - the best-evidenced cross-circle collaboration in the post-coup period.

title: Generation Driven by Faith
note: The posthumous Zayar Thaw release, credited to RAJ as the party that published it rather than to Phyo Zeya Thaw as a performer.
